findings.message: No brand logo asset found: No logo.* asset was found under the scenario's public/asset directories.
findings.suggestion: Generate or add a logo asset (e.g. ui/public/logo.svg) via brand-manager.

findings.message: No brand-manager markers applied: No /* brand-manager:* */ CSS markers or manifest _brand keys were found — the scenario has not adopted a brand-manager-applied brand.
findings.suggestion: Assign and apply a brand via `brand-manager apply` to inject managed markers.

findings.message: Brand name is inconsistent across surfaces: One or more surfaces render a name that disagrees with service.displayName.
findings.suggestion: Align every surface to service.displayName.

findings.message: theme-color disagrees between meta and manifest: The <meta name="theme-color"> value differs from the manifest theme_color, so the chrome and launch colors diverge.
findings.suggestion: Set the manifest theme_color to match the <meta theme-color> (the page is the source of truth).

findings.message: theme-color disagrees with the design-kit surface token: The declared browser/PWA theme color differs from DESIGN.md's surface color token.
findings.suggestion: Set <meta theme-color> and manifest theme_color to the DESIGN.md surface token, or add a DESIGN.md note containing brand-manager:theme-color-token-override with the reason.

findings.message: Brand asset quality issues: A referenced brand asset is empty, transparent where it must be opaque, or the icon set lacks a maskable entry.
findings.suggestion: Flatten the apple-touch-icon onto a solid background, replace empty assets, and add a maskable icon.

findings.message: Custom font is referenced but never loaded: A --font-* token names a custom family, but no @font-face, webfont <link>, or bundled font file loads it — the browser silently falls back.
findings.suggestion: Load the font (self-host an @font-face + bundled woff2, or add a Google-Fonts <link>) or use a system-font stack.

findings.message: No Open Graph link-preview metadata: ui/index.html is missing Open Graph tags, so shared links render without a branded title/description card.
findings.suggestion: Add og:type/title/description/site_name (and an og:image) to ui/index.html.

findings.message: No Twitter card metadata: ui/index.html is missing Twitter (X) card tags, so links shared there fall back to a plain preview.
findings.suggestion: Add twitter:card/title/description (and twitter:image) to ui/index.html.

findings.message: No social preview image is declared: ui/index.html has no og:image or twitter:image metadata for branded link previews.
findings.suggestion: Add a real preview image under /public/ and reference it with og:image and twitter:image.

findings.message: CLI surface does not carry the brand display name: The CLI manifest never mentions service.displayName, so help/banner output reads as the raw slug rather than the product.
findings.suggestion: Reference the display name in the CLI manifest description (or a title) so help output is branded.

findings.message: Public branding assets are not served under the /public/ convention: Branding/PWA/OG assets — or the index.html/manifest references to them — are served at the site root instead of under the /public/ URL prefix.
findings.suggestion: Relocate the assets under ui/public/public/ (served at /public/) and repoint the index.html links + manifest references at /public/.
